decisions.reason: As a 2018 launch that builds directly on the firm’s established airport systems offer in a growing, R&D-intensive market, it is still an early-stage option with meaningful upside and too little negative evidence to justify abandonment in 2019.

This surveillance display also fits the firm’s core integrated airport-operations portfolio, and with only a short market history and no reported poor results, the option value of learning more in 2019 outweighs the cost of dropping it now.
